adapter_changes: train.py: AUTORESEARCH_SEED is executable and emitted; total clock starts before torch import; one AUTORESEARCH_METRICS endpoint
prepare.py: CACHE_DIR pinned to ~/.cache/autoresearch_v2 so the directory listing that defines dataset_split cannot be changed by another campaign sharing ~/.cache/autoresearch

prepare.py: make_dataloader tokenizes on a bounded-FIFO producer thread instead of inline in the training loop. Verified byte-identical token stream, document order and epoch boundaries against the pre-fix dataloader (sha256 of 12 batches of int64 inputs+targets: f4ab4f330294964c6a070fb6f400e06758822a4fa43f35ab672324e8546550ef). Throughput fix only; evaluate_bpb is untouched.

prepare.py: pre-tokenized flat token cache (uint16 tokens + document offsets + per-batch document counts, memory-mapped). The training loop no longer reads parquet or runs the BPE encoder; it replays the identical (token_lists, epoch) sequence from the cache, including the per-batch document grouping, which the best-fit packer is sensitive to. Falls back to inline tokenization when no current cache exists. Throughput change only; verified byte-identical against the inline path by tools/verify_token_cache.py (sha256 of 12 batches of int64 inputs+targets+epoch, both paths: 15fcca1c6bd1502397c287415c722c2c8d8171a604790f62a33f6bf2529a5a1d). evaluate_bpb is untouched.
